{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Exclude QA rows (revenue == 999999.99) and refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
real_orders = sales[
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = real_orders[real_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders from loyal customers
mean_revenue_loyal = loyal_customers['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue_loyal}')"}
